info.title: v2.logistics.update_address
info.description: Use this API to update the address of a shop.

post.description: Use this API to update the address of a shop.

parameters.name: access_token
parameters.description: The token for API access, using to identify your permission to the api. Valid for multiple use and expires in 4 hours.

parameters.name: address
parameters.description: The detailed address description of the address.

parameters.name: address_id
parameters.description: Unique identifier for the address. You can get the address_id via v2.logistics.get_address_list.

parameters.name: geo_info
parameters.description: Geolocation information for the address. Type: JSON string Note: 1) To clear existing geo info, pass "" or {}. 2) To keep existing geo info, do not include this field. 3) The JSON may include optional fields: - formattedAddress (string): full formatted address. - region (object) – contains latitude and longitude as floats. - user_verified (boolean) – whether the geolocation is verified by the user. - user_adjusted (boolean) – whether the geolocation was adjusted by the user.

parameters.name: partner_id
parameters.description: Partner ID is assigned upon registration is successful. Required for all requests.

parameters.name: phone
parameters.description: Contact phone number for the recipient.

parameters.name: region
parameters.description: The region of the address. Note: Do not allow to update the region of the address.

parameters.name: shop_id
parameters.description: Shopee's unique identifier for a shop. Required param for most APIs.

parameters.name: sign
parameters.description: Signature generated by partner_id, api path, timestamp, access_token, shop_id and partner_key via HMAC-SHA256 hashing algorithm. More details: https://open.shopee.com/documents?module=87&type=2&id=58&version=2

parameters.name: timestamp
parameters.description: This is to indicate the timestamp of the request. Required for all requests. Expires in 5 minutes.

200.description: Response documented by Shopee Open Platform.

import requests
import json

url = "https://partner.shopeemobile.com/api/v2/logistics/update_address?access_token=access_token&partner_id=partner_id&shop_id=shop_id&sign=sign&timestamp=timestamp"

payload=json.dumps({

  "city": "São Paulo",
  "district": "Pinheiros",
  "geo_info": "-",
  "name": "Carlos Silva",
  "phone": "+55-11-91234-5678",
  "region": "Brazil",
  "state": "SP",
  "town": "Rua dos Pinheiros",
  "zipcode": "05422-001"
})
headers = {
  'Content-Type': 'application/json'
}
response = requests.RPCRequest("POST",url,headers=headers, data=payload, allow_redirects=False)

print(response.text)
